desc: Dump metadata content of Stratis pools
r: stratis-dumpmetadata - Dump metadata content of Stratis pools
stratis-dumpmetadata prints the metadata content of a Stratis pool that is present on a given block device.
<dl><dt data-o="">-h, --help</dt><dd>Print help information.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-p, --print-bytes</dt><dd>Print byte buffer of device.</dd></dl>
